note: KOA resort on Lake Barkley at Prizer Point, beside the Prizer Point marina with its floating camp store and lakeside restaurant; indoor and outdoor pools, floating cabins and treehouses. The economy gravel water/electric sites have no sewer; a honey wagon comes four days a week. --Claude
summary: Kept: passes the price gate on its own engine ($40 Oct 2027 / $48 Mar / $52 Jul weeknights for a 50A W/E gravel site; full-hookup gravel pull-through $45-57). Fees high 122 -> 142 (waterfront Patio sites Mar/Jul 2027). Added 50A electric, 100 ft max, laundry/store/wifi, season 03-19..11-22, booking url. Google 4.2/722. Waterfront re-audit lead (operator: 'along the waters edge' sites).
flags: PRICE GATE PASSES (private): cheapest real RV night on KOA's engine (Motorhome 23 ft, 2 adults) = $40.00 on Tue 2027-10-19 ('Back In, 50/30/20 Amps, Water/Electric Gravel Water + Electric', sites 10a/25a/39a, no sewer; 'Only 3 sites left!'), $48 on 2027-03-23, $52 on 2027-07-13 (summer weekday). Next type up (full-hookup gravel pull-through, Wabash Way): $45 / $53 / $57. Summer peak dearest type $142. Not a Good Sam Park (stored good_sam false, derived). Google Maps 4.2 stars / 722 reviews (read as acceptable but under 4.5; one 11/5/2026 KOA review: 'Just one problem they need to fix and that is the sewage line. It kept backing up right at our outside table'). Not borderline on price in shoulder seasons; summer weekday $52 for the cheapest type is just over the line.

WATERFRONT RE-AUDIT LEAD (contrary operator claim; stored 'not waterfront' from a 2026-10-19 satellite read): KOA's booking form describes 'Main Channel Back In Gravel Pad Cumberland Ave' sites 01p, 11p-22p as 'Located along the waters edge, these sites even give you the chance to cast a line ... without ever leaving your spot', the 'Deluxe Patio Back In Water Front' sites 508p-515ps as 'just steps from the water's edge ... perfect for fishing from your site, and/or launching a kayak/paddleboard', and the Superior Loop 02ps-09ps as 'on a scenic peninsula ... a true waterfront feel'. On Esri imagery (leaf-on, drawdown) the peninsula loop at ~36.9100,-87.9858 has pads roughly 35-60 m from the east cove's high-water line through partial canopy; the main loops south of the marina cove sit under trees. Site positions were not plotted (no site map read), so this needs a waterfront re-audit with the KOA site map; not changed here.

LONG-STAY: one type (Lagoon concrete back-in, 601L-607L etc.) carries '***Call about our MONTHLY stay special, available from the week after Labor Day until the week before Memorial Day.***' - an off-season monthly offer on one site type; all 19 types sell single nights online. Not a long-stay park.
PIN: stored 36.90891,-87.98723 sits in the main loops just south of the marina cove (Google's pin 36.91184,-87.98917 is the marina/office ~340 m NW). Stored pin is on the campground; no move.
